01.title: Hi, I'm Ekta
01.text: Hi, I'm Ekta. I'm a software engineer in Bengaluru, which means I spend half my life building things and the other half stuck at Silk Board. You're about to ride through my story. Use the arrow keys and Space — or the buttons on screen. Let's go.

02.title: Intel Junction
02.text: My first big stop was Intel. I was an intern doing data engineering and MLOps, and I kept noticing the same thing: smart people doing boring, repetitive work. So I automated it. A deployment pipeline that made ML releases 30% faster. A validation tool that cut manual checking by 70% across a million records.

03.title: Zeta Flyover
03.text: Now I'm at Zeta, building for PayZapp — HDFC Bank's app with over 20 million users. I work on security, loans, and the small details people never notice until they break. When 20 million people use what you ship, 'it works on my machine' stops being a joke. One thing I owned: the mobile-data-only authentication checks across PayZapp's signup and login flows.

04.title: Things I Build
04.text: Outside work, I build things nobody asked me to. An AI tool that writes personalised cold emails from a resume and a job description. A model that puts punctuation into speech transcripts — 95.4% accurate. Yes, Wispr. I was working on your problem before I knew your name.

05.title: The Studio
05.text: This is the part of me that doesn't need a job title. I write poetry. I record videos. Code is how I solve problems; art is how I understand them.

07.title: A mistake I learned from
07.text: Okay, you fell. So have I. Every bug I've hit at work has taught me something — the hurdle cards on this road are a few of them. Dust off, step back, and try again.

08.title: Why Wispr
08.text: You made it through Silk Board — honestly, that's the hardest part of living here. I've already worked on the problem Wispr solves: putting punctuation into speech transcripts, at 95.4% accuracy. I'd love to keep building on it with you. Let's talk.

comma.text: Fun fact: I built a model that puts punctuation into speech transcripts — 95.4% accurate. Sound familiar, Wispr?

lessons.problem: Critical data-ingestion workflows at Intel still ran on basic authentication.
lessons.solved: I migrated them to OAuth 2.0, improving security and compliance readiness.

lessons.problem: Validating 1M+ records by hand was eating everyone's time.
lessons.solved: I built an automated data quality framework with Python, Snowflake and SSAS that cut manual effort by 70%.

lessons.problem: ML releases were slow to ship.
lessons.solved: I built a no-code MLOps pipeline with GitHub Actions, Databricks and MLflow that made releases 30% faster.

lessons.problem: Malformed referral URLs were being saved, which broke referral attribution.
lessons.solved: I analysed the AppsFlyer OneLink templates, validated the URLs, extracted the referral codes and stopped bad ones from being stored.

lessons.problem: Static assets had to move from ImageBucket to Tachyon without breaking any environment.
lessons.solved: I rolled it out step by step behind Firebase Remote Config feature flags.

lessons.problem: One Help Icon had to behave the same across 15+ Android and Flutter screens and every device configuration.
lessons.solved: I integrated it from the Figma specifications and checked it across device configurations and combined builds.
